author: rutledge_s
body:
IGN: SamPlaysMC12 (never changed my name)

Why I was banned: I was banned for hacking (click aimbot / aura)

Why I should be unbanned: I do admit I was hacking at the time about ten months ago, so I do not believe it was a false ban, it was rightly so. Not long after I was banned, I stopped playing minecraft for almost the length of the school year, and have just gotten back into it. Avicus / Mczone was always my go to server when I was bored ever since I started playing mc 2 years ago, and I remember tons of fun times i had on here (hackless). When it got into the summer of 2014, I did indeed install a hacked client, initially for an anarchy (no rules) server but continued to use it on other servers such as this one. I was banned of course, and not long after I was done playing completely when school began. I played again a little winter break, and my hacked client i was using stopped working and kept crashing me (at the time i didn't really use it anymore, it just got me good fps) so I was too lazy to fix it or get another one. It also improved the playing experience a lot too. Now I'm back into minecraft again, and i greatly miss all the fun times i had playing Nebula. I do not have any hacks or clients of any sorts downloaded and I never will, so I would love to be able to play on avicus again.

title: SamPlaysMC12 Infraction appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the effort into your appeal, and due to the fact that your ban was almost a year ago, and there is no evidence, you will be appealed. Please don't break the rules again, they can be found here.

Regards,
Pelpelajax/Aeronautic_,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
